findings.message: Acceptance criterion 1 requires tests/test_phase6_exit.py to prove that `eval/host_loop.py` `run()` writes the closed `HostLoopReport` through its registered ordinary-lane writer. The merged `run(**kwargs) -> HostLoopReport` only returns the validated model; its docstring says 'the caller alone may serialize the report'. The HOST_LOOP_REPORT entry in `squatch/stages.py` `KNOWN_ARTIFACTS` is the lane's validator, applied when the OUTBOX is lifted. It is not called by run(). The ticket forbids engine edits, so this criterion cannot be met as written.
findings.paved_road: Reword criterion 1 (and the matching Scope-in sentence) to follow the merged contract. The exit's own Implement calls `run()`, serializes the returned `HostLoopReport` to `tickets/phase6-exit/host-loop-report.json` in its worktree OUTBOX, and the test proves those bytes validate through `KNOWN_ARTIFACTS[HOST_LOOP_REPORT]` with the required members in schema order (at least three distinct-run `machine_ticket_merge`, then `report_to_regression_bug_loop`, then `escape_attribution`). Treat `exit-receipt.json` the same way through `KNOWN_ARTIFACTS[EXIT_RECEIPT]`.
